sources.title: Crock CM-2 Crock Metal | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database has an exact record for the Crock CM-2 Crock Metal. The page identifies it as a distortion pedal and places the model in the Crock catalog. It was published in March 2007 and includes an exact-model product image listing, confirming that CM-2 Crock Metal is a documented Crock model rather than a generic family entry. The broader Crock catalog is associated with pedals produced in the early 1990s in Kharkiv, Ukraine.
